title: Claude Skills and Memory File
content: Claude writes a file named memory.md itself. This file is where it saves what it learns while working with users. Users do not need to interact with this file directly, but they can use {slash} memory to view its contents. Claude can perform various tasks, but for some, a specialist is needed. Just as in a good adventure, users get to choose a class, such as a mage, scientist, or blacksmith. Skills are predefined sets of instructions for specific tasks. Users can have a code review skill, security review skill, or documentation skill. Each skill tells Claude exactly how to approach that type of work. However, there is a challenge with skills and the general way Large Language Models (LLMs) operate. Users need to be cautious about how they use skills and Claude's capabilities.
